observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== key OpenCulturas modules enabled? ==="
runuser -u dev -- ddev drush pm:list --enabled --no-components -y 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "openculturas|geocoder:geocoder |leaflet|smart_date|address" | head -20
echo "=== HTTP check homepage ==="
runuser -u dev -- ddev curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost/ 2>&1
runuser -u dev -- ddev curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://openculturas.ddev.site/ 2>&1
echo "=== homepage title ==="
runuser -u dev -- ddev curl -s http://localhost/ 2>/dev/null | grep -oE "<title>[^<]*</title>" | head -2
